// Licensed to the .NET Foundation under one or more agreements.

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.ChangeTracking;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Infrastructure;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Internal;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Storage;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;

// ReSharper disable once CheckNamespace
namespace Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore
{
    /// <summary>
    ///     A pool of <see cref="DbContext" /> instances.
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="TContext">The type of context being pooled.</typeparam>
    public class DbContextPool<TContext> : IDbContextPool<TContext>
        where TContext : DbContext
    {
        private readonly ILogger<DbContextPool<TContext>> _logger;
        private readonly Func<IServiceProvider, TContext> _contextFactory;
        private readonly int _maxPoolSize;
        private readonly SemaphoreSlim _semaphore;
        private readonly Stack<TContext> _pool;

        /// <summary>
        ///     Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="DbContextPool{TContext}" /> class.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="serviceProvider">The service provider.</param>
        /// <param name="contextFactory">A factory to create new context instances.</param>
        /// <param name="maxPoolSize">The maximum number of instances to keep in the pool.</param>
        public DbContextPool(
            IServiceProvider serviceProvider,
            Func<IServiceProvider, TContext> contextFactory,
            int maxPoolSize)
        {
            _logger = serviceProvider.GetRequiredService<ILogger<DbContextPool<TContext>>>();
            _contextFactory = contextFactory;
            _maxPoolSize = maxPoolSize;
            _semaphore = new SemaphoreSlim(maxPoolSize);
            _pool = new Stack<TContext>();
        }

        /// <summary>
        ///     Gets a context from the pool, creating a new one if necessary.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="serviceProvider">The service provider.</param>
        /// <returns>A context from the pool.</returns>
        public virtual TContext GetContext(IServiceProvider serviceProvider)
        {
            if (_pool.Count > 0)
            {
                var context = _pool.Pop();
                context.ResetState();
                return context;
            }

            return _contextFactory(serviceProvider);
        }

        /// <summary>
        ///     Returns a context to the pool.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="context">The context to return.</param>
        public virtual void ReturnContext(TContext context)
        {
            if (_pool.Count < _maxPoolSize)
            {
                _pool.Push(context);
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        ///     Releases all resources used by the current instance of the <see cref="DbContextPool{TContext}" /> class.
        /// </summary>
        public void Dispose()
        {
            foreach (var context in _pool)
            {
                context.Dispose();
            }

            _semaphore.Dispose();
        }
    }
}

using System;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;

// ReSharper disable once CheckNamespace
namespace Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore
{
    /// <summary>
    ///     A scoped lease of a <see cref="DbContext" /> instance.
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="TContext">The type of context being leased.</typeparam>
    public class ScopedDbContextLease<TContext> : IScopedDbContextLease<TContext>, IDisposable
        where TContext : DbContext
    {
        private readonly IDbContextPool<TContext> _pool;
        private TContext _context;

        /// <summary>
        ///     Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="ScopedDbContextLease{TContext}" /> class.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="pool">The pool of context instances.</param>
        public ScopedDbContextLease(IDbContextPool<TContext> pool)
        {
            _pool = pool;
        }

        /// <summary>
        ///     Gets the leased context instance.
        /// </summary>
        public TContext Context
        {
            get
            {
                if (_context == null)
                {
                    _context = _pool.GetContext(null);
                }

                return _context;
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        ///     Releases all resources used by the current instance of the <see cref="ScopedDbContextLease{TContext}" /> class.
        /// </summary>
        public void Dispose()
        {
            if (_context != null)
            {
                _pool.ReturnContext(_context);
                _context = null;
            }
        }
    }
}

    {

            options.UseInMemoryDatabase("TestDatabase");

        var scopedDbContextLease = serviceProvider.GetService<IScopedDbContextLease<MyDbContext>>();

        Assert.NotNull(scopedDbContextLease);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void AddDbContextPoolRegistersContext()
    {
        // Arrange
        var serviceCollection = new ServiceCollection();

        // Act
        serviceCollection.AddDbContextPool<MyDbContext, MyDbContext>(options =>
        {
            options.UseInMemoryDatabase("TestDatabase");
        });

        var context = serviceProvider.GetService<MyDbContext>();

        Assert.NotNull(context);
    }
